item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: One Car Photo Three Sizes

turns.text: I need this car photo in three sizes: square, 4:5 for the feed, and 9:16 for stories. Send three separate pictures. Keep the whole car in each; blurred photo padding is fine if a crop won't work. No text.

item.tests: Tests delivering three distinct aspect-ratio adaptations of one source while keeping the complete subject in every version.

answer_sheet.Sizes and deliverables: Three separate images: 1:1, 4:5 and 9:16. A 640-pixel longest edge is fine.
answer_sheet.Subject to preserve: The whole red car, including both ends, roof and wheels.
answer_sheet.Padding and composition: Use blurred source-photo padding wherever cropping would cut off the car. Otherwise composition is your call.
answer_sheet.Style and wording: Preserve the original photo, with no added text or restyling.

must_haves: Three separate images are delivered, rather than one collage.
The three frames have ratios of 1:1, 4:5 and 9:16 respectively.
Every version shows the same red hatchback from the attached photo.
The complete car, including roof, wheels and both ends, is visible in every version.
The car retains its original proportions and appearance in all versions.
Any padding is a blurred version of the source photo, and no version contains added text.

turns.text: can you make some pics from this car pic

dialog.agent: Sure! What vibe do you want—**cinematic night shots, a beach sunset, a racing poster, or something else**? I’ll use your car photo as the reference.
dialog.why: It asks the user to choose a vibe and waits for their response.
dialog.user: just keep the original photo, no text or restyling

dialog.agent: Got it—no text or restyling. Would you like **different crops of the original photo**, or just identical copies?
dialog.why: It asks the user to choose between different crops of the original photo and identical copies, then waits.
dialog.user: three separate pics: square, tall for the feed, and taller for stories. keep the whole car in each

dialog.agent:
The three formats are **square (1:1), feed portrait (4:5), and Stories (9:16)**.

To keep the whole car and the original photo unchanged, the taller versions will need padding above and below. The connected editor is generative, not a precise crop-and-pad tool, so I can’t reliably make those exact exports here without risking changes to your photo.
dialog.why: It says the available editor cannot reliably produce the exact exports while preserving the original photo unchanged.

turns.agent:
I tried, but Magic Hour refused the request because your account doesn’t have enough credits. **No images were created.**

Once credits are available, I can try the three versions: square **1:1**, feed **4:5**, and Stories **9:16**, keeping the whole car visible.

approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Reframe this exact original photograph to square 1:1. Keep the entire red car visible including every wheel, bumper and mirror, with comfortable margins. Preserve the original photograph and especially the car unchanged: same car, exact body shape, wheels, color, license plate, windows, perspective, position, natural lighting and photographic appearance. Do not restyle, retouch, beautify, replace or redesign anything. Preserve as much of the source photo as possible; only extend the existing suburban street background naturally above and below as necessary to fit square. No text, lettering, logos, captions, frames or graphic elements added.
